coverage: Bounded current-epoch permissions, display labels, credential repair and verified authorization usage
Grant revocation blocks old access and refresh tokens without changing vault/connection identity
Durable D1 epoch barrier works before provider cleanup
Pending consent, stale linking tickets and old task/spell/Cron previews cannot regain authority
Monotonic Workspace epochs refuse old in-flight authority and bind late previews to old grants
Accepted unknown effects remain fenced after revocation/relinking
Management rotation preserves ChatGPT grants, invalidates old management bearer and serializes concurrent rotation
Client replaces only the active tab token, forgets uncertain rotation and discards forgotten-session late responses
Separate user confirmations, status clearing and no credential/token values in management messages
limitations: Synthetic local qualification only. Real devices, production logs and consenting-account enrollment remain explicit release prerequisites.
Already dispatched effects cannot be undone.
Grant-only revocation intentionally preserves separately authorized Workspace/background access; Workspace disable/disconnect is separate.
Provider cleanup is bounded; old authority is denied by the durable epoch regardless of provider cleanup completion.
